items.title: Frank Capp interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, September 3, 1995
items.q: Art Pepper, Stan Getz, I worked with Marty Paich.

ctx.x: What about some of the, you’ve worked with some great soloists too — Art Pepper, and Stan Getz.
Art Pepper, Stan Getz, I worked with Marty Paich. In fact, did you know Marty Paich, the pianist?
I know of him. I never met him.
